root.label: Israeli elections committee votes to disqualify two Arab-majority parties

events.label: Israeli elections committee votes to disqualify two Arab-majority parties

slots.name: parties disqualified
slots.sentence: Last week, the Israeli elections committee voted to disqualify the country’s two main Arab-majority parties.

events.label: Israeli Supreme Court allows Arab parties to contest October 2026 election

slots.name: parties allowed
slots.sentence: Israel's Supreme Court on Friday said that four Arab parties may compete in the Israeli parliamentary elections at the end of this month.

slots.name: judges opposed
slots.sentence: Two of the nine judges, however, opposed this decision, Israeli newspaper Haaretz reported.

slots.name: election date
slots.sentence: The Court's decision means the United Arab List party, commonly known as Ra'am, and the Joint List, consisting of the Hadash, Balad and Ta'al parties, may run in the parliamentary vote on October 27.

slots.name: Arab population percentage
slots.sentence: Arabs make up around one fifth of Israel's population.
